tickets.title: hud_sonic start accepts timeout_s instead of refusing it
tickets.what: Session scan (sonic j52c7712b41ba4a70): 8 pi worker calls `hud_sonic {task, timeout_s}` failed with `start or wait for sonic, not both` (src/worker/tools.ts:254) because the description says 'timeout_s defaults to 480' as if it were a start option. Make start ignore-or-accept timeout_s (it has no meaning on start: drop it silently or keep it for the later wait), and word the description so timeout_s belongs to wait. Keep `wait` + `task` together an error, naming the field.

acceptance.text: `hud_sonic {task, timeout_s}` starts the child
`hud_sonic {task, wait}` still fails and the message names `wait`
Tool description says timeout_s applies to wait
Unit test covers both

tickets.title: A worker report sent in the gap before its next turn prompt is accepted, not lost
tickets.what: Scan (sonic j2cfddd907cde7d8c F1): agy `hud_report` rejected with `use the turn token from the prompt you are answering` because HUD advanced the job turn before the turn-2 prompt was delivered (2 of 60 agy reports; worker re-sent the whole report). Accept the previous turn's token while the next prompt is not yet delivered (or park the report for that turn), so no finished report is refused.

acceptance.text: Reproduced in a unit test: turn advanced, prompt not delivered, report with the old token is accepted for the old turn
A report with a token older than that still fails as today
No double settlement when the next prompt then arrives

tickets.title: Sonic runner deaths leave a diagnosable record
tickets.what: Scans (j5b0fbe7ad17f060f F5, j52c7712b41ba4a70 F2): 6 sonic children failed with `sonic runner exited without an exit receipt`; their sonic-session.jsonl ends `stopReason: aborted`, two died in the same millisecond when the parent imp's session restarted; all 27 headless stderr.log files are empty. Record the runner's exit code/signal and stderr on the receipt-missing path, write a partial report from the session tail when one exists, and name the cause ('parent session restarted' when the parent restarted).

acceptance.text: Receipt-missing failures record exit code or signal and a stderr tail in STATUS/job record
A child aborted by its parent's restart says so in exit_reason
If the sonic session has assistant text, a partial report.md marked partial is written
Unit tests with a synthetic aborted runner

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: Likely cause (carbon review j91fa6e1950156406 #6): `src/roles/worker-tree.ts:126` exempts a child `sonic-run` session from the worker-tree reap only when `slot === 'headless'`; a tab worker's (`primary`) reap SIGTERMs live sonic children. Fix that first and confirm with a test; also check inherited heap caps (`scripts/dist-lock.mjs:48-52`) do not reach child pi processes (`src/mcp/sonic-process.ts:24`).

tickets.title: Land failure evidence shows the failing assertion, not blank panel frames
tickets.what: Scans (j5b0fbe7ad17f060f F3, j2cfddd907cde7d8c F3, j52c7712b41ba4a70 F4, j632148defd832215 F10): the 8 KiB gate excerpt and the 40-line repair tail are often blank TUI frame lines (one excerpt 83 of ~100 lines blank; repair tails cut before the assertion); land failure notices say only `failed: repair 1`. Strip blank/whitespace-only and rendered-frame lines before excerpting, always include the first failing test block (`not ok`/`✖` + assertion) of each failing file, and put the failing step and test names in the failure notice.

acceptance.text: Excerpt and repair tail contain no whitespace-only runs; each failing test's name and assertion appear
Failure notice names the step and up to 3 failing tests
Unit tests over a synthetic gate log with panel frames

tickets.title: Failed launch error says which pane and retries once on a busy pane
tickets.what: Scans: 595 of 631 jobs record herdr_pane w5D:p1 (the caller's pane) incl. headless ones; 4 launches failed `agent_pane_busy` when several were created in the same second; `exit_reason` sometimes holds a raw CLI JSON blob (6 jobs). Headless jobs should not record the caller's pane as their own; a pane-busy launch retries once after a short delay; exit_reason stores a short code with the JSON kept in stderr_tail.

acceptance.text: Headless job records have no herdr_pane (or a field clearly marked caller_pane)
Simulated agent_pane_busy retries once then fails with a clear message
exit_reason is a short code; raw JSON only in stderr_tail
Unit tests

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: Also (carbon #6, fable #8): record the attempted agent args in launch diagnostics (src/mcp/dispatch/harness-cli.ts:184-187) and treat herdr `invalid_agent_argument` as a before-input failure (src/mcp/dispatch/proc.ts:56-63,138) so it falls through to the next place or the prompt-file fallback.

tickets.title: Small MCP contract fixes from the session scan
tickets.what: From the scans: (a) hud_report summary: schema maxLength 320 vs description '160 code points' — one number; (b) hud_tickets update `unknown acceptance item: 4` should list the valid range and validate the whole tick list before writing; (c) placement-option refusal on non-general roles names the offending field(s); (d) hud_roster shows imp routing presets (`hard: astra`) that hud_create refuses — say these are chosen by auto-route, not passable; (e) pi `hud-sonic-ready` notices are not sent for a child whose report the same session already collected with `hud_sonic wait` (37% redundant); (f) watch.log logs an unresolved worker-tree snapshot once per job, not every minute.

acceptance.text: Each of (a)-(f) fixed with a unit test or updated snapshot
Tool schema bytes do not grow by more than 200 B total

tickets.title: Huge hud_read full results stay within the client's tool-result limit
tickets.what: Main session: `hud_read {job, mode: full}` on a 57 KB oracle report exceeded Claude Code's tool-result limit and was spilled to a file; scan j632148defd832215 F9 saw ~40 KB cuts needing a second read. Return full report text up to a safe size (e.g. 24 KB) and for longer reports return the first part plus `report_path`, byte size and an offset/next hint so the rest can be read in pages (hud_read accepts an offset).

acceptance.text: Report > limit returns a bounded first page, total size and a way to get the next page
Paging to EOF reproduces the report exactly
Reports under the limit are unchanged

tickets.title: Worktrees kept after landing say which paths kept them, and setup offers disposable globs
tickets.what: Scans: bilingual 20/20 imp worktrees kept ('dirty' from ignored files like scripts/__pycache__/ and tests/evidence/), MyHUD 44 kept; reap sweep removed=0 kept=36. By design ignored files are kept unless `.hud/project.json` worktree.disposable globs match (src/mcp/managed-worktree.ts:216-254). Record the first few blocking paths in worktree_kept_reason, and have `hud setup` (and Settings if cheap) propose disposable globs from the ignored paths seen in kept worktrees for the owner to accept. No silent deletion of ignored files. Also a real bug (2026-11-23, flow f9fb00124014d9e2d): `matchesGlob(rel, 'dir/**')` does not match dot-named paths, so a worktree whose only leftovers were `.tsbuild/native/cargo/.rustc_info.json`, `.../.fingerprint/...` (native Rust build) was kept although `.tsbuild/**` is disposable. A disposable `dir/**` glob must cover every path under `dir/`, dotfiles included (e.g. match with dot segments allowed, or treat a trailing `/**` as a prefix).

acceptance.text: worktree_kept_reason lists up to 5 blocking paths
`hud setup` shows proposed disposable globs from kept worktrees and writes them only when accepted
Live: a bilingual-like synthetic worktree with only __pycache__ is reaped after accepting the glob
A worktree whose only ignored leftovers are dot-named files under a disposable `dir/**` glob is removed after landing (unit test with `.tsbuild/x/.lock`)

tickets.title: Same-brief jobs are distinguishable on Home
tickets.what: Three general jobs dispatched from one brief with different models all show `Open review: ho…` on Home and cannot be told apart (Home no longer shows the model, D-2026-11-22-24). When two or more visible rows share a title, append a short distinguishing tag (preset or model short name) to those rows only.

acceptance.text: Rows with identical titles show a short model/preset tag; unique titles unchanged
Frames updated EN/ZH at 42 and 80 columns
